title: Prepare the operating activities section of the statement of cash flows using the indirect method

items.concept: Full indirect OA section: noncash G/L and expense adjustments; WC schedule; AccDep and bond premium rollforwards; period-end adjusting JEs; equipment disposal and bond retirement JEs; investing/financing classification and ASC 230 disclosures
Number-variant twin: indirect OA with bond discount amortization, stock-based compensation, land/equipment disposal G/L, and mixed WC changes
Alternate OA adjustments: equity-method income vs dividends, deferred tax asset/liability changes, unrealized FV-NI gain, WC; related period JEs
Sign of OA adjustment for bond premium amortization under the indirect method
Classification/presentation of PPE disposal gain and cash proceeds under the indirect method
